header.about: Quicksilver weave, the pick and the volley expectation. The spells of every case are the `book` in balance_keys (number, req_level, energy per cast, min and max, [inc, levels] growth for each, level cap, magery code, magery level, target, duration, element, resist mode, [ability, value] slots). kind weaver: the proc chance by class magery code and level (null when the class does not weave). kind budget: the proc budget at a level. kind power: the volley power percent from a budget and twice the volley average. kind pick: the engine's pick for a class and level against a target (immunity and what the spell spares), as spell number, twice the volley average, power percent and the spell number of each hit. kind proc: the exact mean damage (`unresisted`, the mean over every roll of every hit, run through the engine's own damage code, element and magic resistance) of one proc for a character with the casting stat `stat` and spell damage bonus `bonus` percent, and `resist_rolls`, how many of the 99 values of the resist roll stop it. The level is the character's. v120 is the 1.20.0 balance; neutral exists only for weaver (chance 0).
